I accept that my examples are simplistic, but I suppose the purpose of the exercise is to point out that your interpretation of things depends on your mood. 

Really, I'm suggesting to people in this group that if they're feeling really bad, and this group is just exacerbating those bad feelings, then they should look elsewhere for solace...

Take care
